title: Give HQ a status for work that is waiting on purpose
ask: Daniel ruled Q-90 option (a): projects get a third status — waiting — which carries the event that will wake it and the decision that put it there. Today a project parked by his own ruling reads either `blocked`, which puts an instruction to do the parked thing at the top of his dashboard and starts a 7-day amber clock against Product, or `planned`, which hides the wait completely.
first_action: Add the status to the project schema with its two fields (the waking event, and the decision that set it), teach hq/server.py's signals and the program report to read it — it must not enter the Eye of Sauron as an unblock action, must not feed nothing-blocked-too-long, and must not join api_program's gating set — then move replay-phase-b and close-m15-gate onto it and show the wake-up on the project page.
